breakdown.description: For curved flow, pressure is higher on the outside of the turn to provide the required centripetal force; stating pressure increases toward the center reverses the correct direction of the pressure gradient.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'The pressure increases toward the center of curvature,' which is the same incorrect claim from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth indicates pressure increases outward (away from the center of curvature) per the normal momentum balance dP/dn = ρV²/R with n directed outward. The agent repeated the original error rather than correcting it.
